modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Sengun (eye) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.
injury.detail: Sengun suffered a blow to the face during Wednesday's game against Indiana, and his availability is now in jeopardy for Friday's tilt. The Rockets should have another update on the big man closer to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Adams (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
injury.detail: The right quad contusion is a new concern for Adams, who has appeared in two of Houston's last three outings following an 11-game absence due to a right soleus strain. If the big man joins Clint Capela (ankle) on the inactive list, Oscar Tshiebwe, Jabari Smith and Tari Eason would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Hunter (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: Hunter has been bothered by left hip soreness. While it kept him off the floor for Sunday's 125-103 loss to the Thunder, he returned for Wednesday's meeting with the Suns. If Hunter can't suit up Friday, it could mean more minutes for Leaky Black and Alex Karaban.

injury.shortComment: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
injury.detail: Okpara will shed his questionable tag due to an illness and suit up Friday. However, the two-way player isn't guaranteed to see the floor.
